export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/gautam-tube-corporation) states "Total Shipments 103 Records detected" and lists dated export rows, e.g. "2026-01-28 GAUTAM TUBE CORPORATION VOLT CUBE TECHNICAL SERVICES CO. IS 1239 GALVANIZED IRON ERW PIPE WITH COUPLER SIZE: 2 NB X 3.60 MM THK X 6 MTRLONG- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Bahrain 73063090 9120449"; also "2026-01-13 ... JACOBI CARBONS LANKA (PVT) LTD ... STAINLESS STEEL SHEET / PLATE SS310 GR -1250 MM X 1500 MM X 10 MM THK- NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Colombo, Sri Lanka 72191200 8716456" and "2025-10-28 ... STAINLESS STEEL SEAMLESS PIPE SS310 GR-SIZE:1/2\" NB X SCH 40 X 470 MMM LONG SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India COLOMBO, Sri Lanka 73044100 8877077". Counter check: page header claims 103 total shipments, but only 5 individual shipment rows were visible on the free view (rows seen = 5 vs counter = 103); ports listed: NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 (4), Colombo (3), Bahrain (1).
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes 73063090, 72191200 and 73044100, destinations Bahrain and Sri Lanka, B/L numbers 9120449, 8716456, 8877077, 5088181, 9911405, latest cargo 2026-01-28. Declared HS 730630 matches the 2026-01-28 galvanized ERW pipe line (73063090), so the HS claim is consistent with actual shipments; the company also ships stainless steel pipes/sheets under other HS codes. Note the declared industry 'IT и электроника' is inconsistent with the actual product range (steel pipes/tubes) — this is a classification remark only, not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search returned connection errors on both attempts, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and no public GST/tender record was located — so domestic_status is unknown, not 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views: null, not estimated. No CIN/PAN found in sources; PAN field left empty as claimed.
